defects.claim: A texImage2D throw in withTexture skips the unbind and cache update, so the binding cache goes stale and a later draw may skip a required texture bind
defects.scenario: A tainted source makes texImage2D throw during creation; the cache keeps a stale binding and a later draw skips its bind; the allocated texture leaks
defects.cause: no cleanup path when upload throws

defects.claim: A texImage2D throw during texture creation leaks the newly allocated texture handle, which is never deleted
defects.scenario: A tainted source makes texImage2D throw during creation; the cache keeps a stale binding and a later draw skips its bind; the allocated texture leaks
defects.cause: no cleanup path when upload throws

defects.claim: A null fragment createShader throws before constructor cleanup, leaking the already-created vertex shader
defects.scenario: Fragment createShader returns null after the vertex stage is compiled; the vertex shader leaks
defects.cause: stage cleanup covers only stages that reached constructor cleanup
